content: Kulurtak a Jesu Jerusalem alut
Anmani Jerusalem anheinai a, Bethphage le Bethany khopui modonna, Olive chingtang a anhong je. Jesu ning ama thiemroi inni ma aleitir
hi-ang hin aleiti: <<Ninma kho-a se ru, son nintung ri Salungdai atute ning anluchong mak inkhat ankhit ninmu sik. Khawa kha heisut inlang hin heikei ru.
Khan atumi inkhat ning, <Ang sik mi kha nintho e?> anahei ti inchu, Akupu
ning a aneiman nomna aom, khan aheithak nok kalen sik tiru.>>
Khana anmani ning anse-a lamsir-a Salungdai inkhat innkol anleikhit kha anleimu, Anmani ning ansut lai,
khawa khan akingir alek ngaining anmanideng anleirakal, <<Angsik mo Salungdai ninsut e?>>
Anmani ning anleimasang Jesu ning aleiminjet na ang a, khan alei kingir ngai khaning anlei minchoi je.
Anmanining salungdai kha Jesu deng anhei roi-a, achunga anpon ngai salungdai chunga andap a, khan Jesu ning salungdai chunga aleichuong.
Mi katamtak ngaining lampui a anpon anpha a, alek ngaining lei kolla thingbaak anwatuk a khan lampui-a anleipha pe.
Khan amadonna akase le anuk kujui mingai khaning an-ong anleiphut, <<Pathien minpak ru! Puma riming a akahong amakha amachal atha!
Akahong sik nipa Reng David rengram kha Pathien ning ralwantha pe rase. Pathien minpak ru!>>
Jesu Jerusalem aheilut a, Bek-inn sunga alut a, khan amaning ang rikip a-en. Tak kholei ahongtung je jarra athiemroi somle-inni ngai le Bethany teng anleisuok je.
Jesu ning theichang kung ahakser
Ajing kini-a, anmani ning Bethany ria anhong kir nok a, Jesu awon aleicham je.
Akalaktak ria theichang kung abo kinbur inkhat aleimu, akara ngaikha a-om sik mi tia aka-en alei se. Tak amun atung karra, abo bei awamu je, ajarchu theichang ngai kinra pha lei imak.
Jesu ning theichang kung deng khan aleiti, <<Nakara atute ning bak nok rang muru su!>> Khan ama thiemroi ngaining achongril kha anlei jet.
Jesu Bek-inn aleise

Anmani Jerusalem anheitung karra, Jesu Bek-inna aleise, Bek-inna neinak akajor le akaracho ngaiseng kha akaholsuok aleiphut jei. Amaning sumsan kuthul ngai le pharphili kajor ngai ankin-ongna ngai kha amalet pe je,
khan Bek-inn sumpuk kutung khan neinak kuchoi atute inkhat num leiminlut mak je.

Jesu ning khawa so-a mingai deng aminchu je: <<Khachu hiwa anghin akinje khachu Pathien ning aleiti, <Kei bek-inn hi jat rikip ngai nina inn akinti sik e.> Tak nangni ning muruk kinthupna ninminchang je!>>
Thiempu kolok ngai le Dan oja ngaining khawakha anjet je, khawa jarra ama that nasik a lampui aka-entok anphut jei. Anmani ning amakha anchi, ajarchu mipui ngai ning ama minchuna kha kinlak anleisak.
Kholei aheitung a, Jesu le ama thiemroi ngai khopui kha anleimathaan jei.
Theichang kung ri-a kinchuna
Jingteng ma, anmani lampui a anse lai, theichang kung kha anleimu. Khawakha arujung kutung a aleichar je.
Peter ning omchen akosuok kha amindon na Jesu deng aleiti, <<Oja, Enro, nahakser theichang kung kha achar je!>>
Jesu ning anmanideng aleimasang, <<Pathien taksen na nei ru.

Keining akidiktak kiniril pe e, atu-tu inum hiwa chingbung hi kinphuk inlang tui-ongpui lai-a tanasik chong ape a khan amulung kei-chi o na neilei-a, takkha aril na chung a asuok nger sik tia akataksen mi khadeng akintho sik e.
Khawa jarra kini minjet e: nangni ning Pathien nina ninnei a angmikhat ninni karra, kinmu je tia taksen ru, khan ninni rikip ngaikha akinpe sik e.
Khan ningir a Pathien deng nina ninnei karra, marwan na akaom Ninpa khaning nintho thel ngairikip ana rangai mindam nasik a, atumi inkhat chung a mulung hoimak na ninnei rikip kha rangai mindam ru.>>
Jesu thotorna chungchang rakalna
Anmani Jerusalem a woikhat anhong tung nok je. Khanna Jesu kha Bek-inn sunga aleilon lai, thiempu kolok, Dan oja ngai khan upa ngai amadenga anlei hong
khan amadeng aleirakal, <<Hiwa ngai thotor nasik a ang ranak mo nanei? Hiwa thotorna hi atu ningmo anape e?>>
Jesu ning anmanideng aleimasang, <<Keining chong inkhatbei narakal kate, khan nangning khawa kha nana masang inchu, keining ang thotorna ngai ningmo hiwa ngai hi kathotor e ti kini minjet sik.
John ning baptized thotorna ranak anei kha khona ria mi, niti pe ru: Pathien ria a-imakli miring ria mi?>>
Anmani inkhat le inkhat ankinkher phut je: <<Angmi niti sik? <Pathien ria e,> niti inle kha amaning, <Kha-inchu angsik mo John kha taksen lei nin e?> ati sik.
Takkha miring ria niti inum>> (Anmani ning mipui ngai kha anlei chi, ajarchu mi rikip ning John kha chongkachoi pa e tia anlei.)
Khawa jarra anmani ning Jesu deng aleimasang khachu, <<Keini jet mung.>> Jesu ning anmanideng aleiti, <<Kha inchu, kisintho ngai hi ang thotorna ningmo katho e nangnideng niminjet noning.>>

footnotes.text: Manuscripts alek a alam 26 akinchal: Milak ninrangai mindam mak inchu, marwan a akaom ninpa ning nangni thothel na ngai rangai mindam nape noning (Mat 6:15 a anri)
